ai_overview.markdown:
A [push present](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Push_present) is `a gift given by a partner to a new mother to celebrate the birth of their child`.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Push_present)

### Meaning and Purpose

- **Appreciation:** It honors the physical, emotional, and mental hard work of pregnancy and labor.
- **Naming:** The term comes from the physical act of "pushing" during childbirth, though it applies regardless of how the baby is delivered.
- **Timing:** It can be given during pregnancy, in the delivery room, or weeks later during the postpartum recovery period.[[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DHXxbY9zY-d/)[[2]](https://armansfinejewellery.com/blogs/news/what-is-a-push-present-and-why-you-deserve-one)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Push_present)[[4]](https://www.a-hjort.com/faq/push-presents-ideas-rules-and-what-to-do/)

### Common Types of Gifts

- **Jewelry:** Traditional choices include rings, necklaces, or bracelets featuring the baby's birthstone.
- **Keepsakes:** Sentimental items or personalized family mementos.
- **Practical Support:** High-end electronics, designer items, or acts of service that help with postpartum rest.[[1]](https://www.reddit.com/r/BabyBumps/comments/15mxhbq/has_anyone_heard_of_a_push_present/)[[2]](https://www.therubypostnatal.com/what-is-a-push-gift-why-it-matters-and-10-best-ideas/)[[3]](https://thisisladyland.com/push-presents-do-we-deserve-a-gift-for-giving-birth/)[[4]](https://www.thebump.com/a/perfect-push-presents-for-new-moms)
